corrections.why: NHLR's 'Administered by' field names U.S. Fish & Wildlife. Its 'Cooperators' field names the Mississippi Forestry Commission. The earlier draft read the Forestry Commission as the agency, which misread the page. USFWS also governs the refuge the tower stands in (cite 3). The brief's entry matched NHLR's administrator field.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief lists U.S. Fish & Wildlife, which matches NHLR's 'Administered by' field. NHLR also lists the Mississippi Forestry Commission as a cooperator. No source read states who owns the tower.

sources.title: Sam D. Hamilton Noxubee National Wildlife Refuge

notes_for_editor: Agency: NHLR lists U.S. Fish & Wildlife under 'Administered by' and the Mississippi Forestry Commission under 'Cooperators'. This supersedes the earlier draft's reading that the Forestry Commission was the agency. Build date unknown after three searches. The 2023 standing note and the NGS datasheet text come from a secondary copy on the Forest Lookouts page; the original datasheet was not fetched. Goose Overlook (Wikipedia) and the Webster overlook in the refuge trail brochure are different structures and were not used. No access or visit rules were found.
